# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle with retry and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Python-specific TDD execution pod (code gen + container execution) |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase via LLM |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment to write |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for container |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container runner |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, and deduplication |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD and ML experiments to database |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client for multiple providers |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes insights into playbook bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval of relevant bullets for queries |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | Context-aware retrieval with reasoning (CGR³) |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity |
| LocalAuditClient | src/audit/local_client.py | Local SQLite audit client for development/testing |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation.py | Blind evaluation of outputs without knowing agent identity |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Multi-candidate blind feature build across models |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Multi-language TDD runner across different LanguagePods |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Reviews test quality before implementation |
| ProjectArchitect | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Decomposes project spec into module dependency DAG |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | src/contracts/module_tdd_builder.py | Builds module implementations using TDD methodology |
| ProjectBuilder | src/cli/project_builder.py | Builds project modules in dependency order |
| TDDRunHandle | src/cli/factory.py | Owns sandbox container lifecycle for one `ace tdd` invocation |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as run_cycle.py
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant CycleRunner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    loop for each cycle (max_iterations)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner
        Runner->>CycleRunner: run(spec)
        activate CycleRunner

        Note over CycleRunner: RED phase
        CycleRunner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
        deactivate Container
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        alt RED aborted or never pulsed
            Pod-->>CycleRunner: CycleResult(success=False)
            deactivate Pod
            CycleRunner-->>Runner: cycle result
            deactivate CycleRunner
            Note right of Runner: exit loop if abort
        else RED passes (test fails correctly)
            Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult(passed=False)
            deactivate Pod
            Note over CycleRunner: GREEN phase with retries
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                activate LLM
                LLM-->>Worker: code
                deactivate LLM
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, impl})
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                alt GREEN passed
                    Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult(passed=True)
                    deactivate Pod
                    break
                else GREEN failed and not abort
                    Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult(passed=False, output)
                    deactivate Pod
                    Note right of CycleRunner: set error_feedback for next retry
                end
            end
            alt GREEN succeeded
                Note over CycleRunner: REFACTOR phase
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                activate LLM
                LLM-->>Worker: code
                deactivate LLM
                Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, refactored})
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult
                deactivate Pod
                Note over CycleRunner: Learning loop
                CycleRunner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                activate Reflector
                Reflector-->>CycleRunner: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Reflector
                CycleRunner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Curator
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                activate Playbook
                Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
                deactivate Playbook
                Curator-->>CycleRunner: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Curator
                CycleRunner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                activate Logger
                Logger-->>CycleRunner: OK
                deactivate Logger
                CycleRunner-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=True)
            else GREEN failed after all retries
                CycleRunner-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            end
            deactivate CycleRunner
        end
        alt cycle complete or planner says COMPLETE
            Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
            deactivate Runner
            break
        end
    end
    deactivate Runner
```
